```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
locations <- read_csv("data/movebank_data.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(date = as_date(timestamp))


```

```{r}
locations_selected <- locations |>
  select(
    individual_local_identifier,
    date,
    location_long,
    location_lat
  )

gt(head(locations_selected))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

keep <- c("LA1", "LA2", "LA3", "LA4", "LA5")
animals_selected <- locations_selected %>% filter(individual_local_identifier %in% keep)
  
```


```{r}
locations_grouped <- animals_selected |>
  group_by(date, individual_local_identifier)

gt(head(locations_grouped))
```

```{r}
locations_sum <- locations_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Longitude = median(location_long, na.rm = TRUE),
    Latitude = median(location_lat, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(head(locations_sum))
```


```{r}
ggplot(
  locations_sum,
  aes(x=Longitude, y= Latitude)
)+
geom_point()

```
```{r}
min_lon <- locations_sum |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

max_lon <- locations_sum |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

min_lat <- locations_sum |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

max_lat <- locations_sum |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(
  locations_sum,
  aes(x=Longitude, 
      y=Latitude,
      colour=individual_local_identifier)
)+
  geom_point()+
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_lon - 0.1, max_lon + 0.1), ylim = c(min_lat - 0.1, max_lat + 0.1)) +
  theme_minimal()

```
